# principle-minimize-reader-load

Trace a real call. Count indirection, mutable scope and hidden state. Inline one-caller forwarding wrappers unless an invariant requires them.

Read this leaf before applying it. In the final report, cite this principle only if it changed a specific decision and state that decision.
